name: print-social-dark-party-photo-carousel-cover-you-bought-tickets-for-a-girls-night-out
title: Girls Night Out Ticket Resale Cover
whatItIs: An Instagram carousel cover over a dark blurry party photograph with a small ticket logo at the top, a giant white heavy headline 'YOU BOUGHT TICKETS FOR A GIRLS NIGHT OUT.', a lighter line 'Your boyfriend said you shouldn't go.', a bold reply 'We love that for you.' and a dim pointer line, with a slide counter.
whatItMeans: A cheeky story-style hook over an unfocused party photo makes a ticket resale service feel like a friend's gossip.
techniques: Blurry party photograph as the backdrop
Centred giant headline with a punchline below
Three text tiers by size and brightness
Small slide counter in the corner

vocabulary.definition: An opening line built to stop the scroll.
Lines of decreasing size and brightness.
A logo shaped like an admission ticket with notches.
